notes: Vare-Washington has free before and after school care in the building, through the City’s Extended Day, Extended Year program. Dismissal is 2:54 pm, earlier than at most schools nearby. Most outside programs start at 3:30, so ask each one when its staff collect.

For grades 6–8, Zhang Sah takes children through 8th grade and Queen & Rook through age 16. Ask the other programs about older children. Fleisher is about half a mile away for children old enough to walk.

days.name: Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Day

notes: ICS runs its own after-school program at the school, the 21st Century Community Learning Center, funded by the Pennsylvania Department of Education. It has a listing here; ask the school how to sign up and whether it costs anything.

ICS keeps its own calendar, and its days off aren’t the District’s: it is open on Veterans Day and on November 16, for instance, and closed on December 11 and March 19 for report card days. The days off on this page come from the ICS calendar; the days-off planner and the list of who’s open go by the District’s, so check a camp’s dates against ICS’s.

Wednesdays are early-dismissal days at ICS, and programs handle them differently. ICS’s own program starts at 1:30 pm that day, Philly InMovement picks up from ICS on Wednesdays only, ZAZZ charges extra for its Wednesday early pickup, and Beehive doesn’t pick up on ICS’s half-day Wednesdays. Ask each program how Wednesdays work.
If you know a program that serves ICS and isn’t here, send it in and it goes on this page.

name: Albert M. Greenfield School
dismissalNote: the school day is 8:21 am to 3:00 pm; Beacon and Yous both collect children at 2:50
notes: Greenfield’s own site names the programs that pick up at the school: Martial Posture, Move Makers, Evolve Dance, Philly Dance Fitness (its kids’ program is ZAZZ), Makom, Philly Arts Center, Kids on 12th and Beacon. Each has a listing here.
Several programs need a minimum number of children from one school (ZAZZ and Makom need four), and several don’t pick up on half days. Ask before counting on a half day.
If you know a program that serves Greenfield and isn’t here, send it in and it goes on this page.
